question.question: Of Redfen, Ashgrove and Millbrook, which district has the fewest pupils per school in 2025/26, and how many pupils per school separate the highest of the three from the lowest?

S1.answer:
Redfen has the fewest pupils per school: 314.7 pupils per school. Millbrook is highest at 370.8, so the difference is 56.1 pupils per school.

ANSWER: Redfen | 56.1
